hypotheses.name: Relative persistence contrast vs matched background
hypotheses.method: Seed42 run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; compared relative filtration-connectivity contrasts (anchor vs matched background complexes) against an H93-style weighted-filtration backbone with anchor-permutation, random-background, and label-permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.00188; positive rows=3/12; positive mean domain-splits=2/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact relative-contrast construction unless anchor/background pairing is materially changed.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Current formulation underperforms the H93 backbone and is null-gap negative in all domain-splits.

hypotheses.name: Persistence derivative-spectrum descriptors
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}; derived filtration-trajectory derivative features and tested additive lift over H70 using quantile-order permutation, derivative-sign randomization, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.00621; positive rows=12/24; positive mean domain-splits=4/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Only revisit once with a materially changed interaction-only design on top of robust H91/H93 features.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model OT alignment with monotone depth warp
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot across immune/lung/external_lung using joint scGPT layers {7,11}; built GO-module role vectors, selected best monotone depth warp by OT cost, and evaluated concordance under module-membership permutation, depth-order permutation, random monotone warp, and random-subspace nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.57065; mean null-gap(q95)=-0.09697; positive null-gap domains=0/3
hypotheses.next_action: Re-retire cross-model branch; only reopen with a fundamentally different shared-representation anchor and strict fast-fail criteria.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change rescue still failed q95 null-gap gate in all pilot domains.
